name: Initia iUSD
oneLiner: iUSD is a single-chain Initia wrapper of bridged Agora AUSD; reserve yield is redirected to ecosystem incentives and redemption routes through AUSD.
collateral: 1:1 reserve in Agora AUSD bridged to Initia via LayerZero; AUSD itself is backed by short-dated U.S. Treasury bills, overnight reverse repos, and cash held in a bankruptcy-remote Delaware Statutory Trust managed by VanEck and custodied by State Street
pegMechanism: iUSD is a single-chain wrapper of bridged Agora AUSD on Initia. Each iUSD is minted against an equal amount of AUSD locked at the Initia LayerZero bridge endpoint; reserve yield from the underlying AUSD is redirected by Initia into ecosystem incentives (Echelon lending, liquidity programs, Cabal vaults) rather than to holders. Holder redemption ultimately depends on the AUSD bridge and Agora's direct USD redemption.

notices.title: New chain, no published proof-of-reserves for the wrapper
notices.message: iUSD lives on Initia, a recently launched Move-based Cosmos L1 with limited operational history. Initia has not yet published a dedicated transparency feed for the AUSD-backed iUSD wrapper; reserve trust currently inherits from Agora's published AUSD attestations plus the LayerZero bridge endpoint. Redemption to USD ultimately routes back through the AUSD bridge to Agora.

mintAuthority.summary: Initia iUSD is a single-chain wrapper of Agora AUSD bridged via LayerZero; each iUSD is minted on Initia against AUSD locked/burned at the LayerZero bridge endpoint, so supply is controlled by the bridge/OFT route rather than a local CDP or issuer.

controls.label: iusd-vault contract (mints iUSD 1:1 against AUSD0 deposits)
controls.capDescription: iUSD is minted by the iusd-vault contract (0x2981d795...) 1:1 against AUSD0 deposited. There is no fixed token cap: effective capacity rises when more AUSD0 is deposited, while outstanding supply remains bounded by deposited AUSD0. The vault is the only entity that can invoke the mint_ref through the 0xfd6a07 sticky Move object's ExtendRef.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: User bridges AUSD0 via LayerZero OFT (0xf407bc...); OFT mints AUSD0 on Initia; AUSD0 deposited to vault object 0xfd6a07...; vault uses ExtendRef to generate signer for 0xfd6a07 and calls managed_coin::Capabilities to mint iUSD 1:1.
routeChecks.caps: No cap beyond AUSD0 supply deposited. LayerZero DVN/security config not independently resolved. vault::ModuleStore.base_token = AUSD0 (0x8078cf9...).

controls.evidence: Initia REST (rest.initia.xyz): 0xfd6a07594842ac5d7501ff55243aff06e4f991f320828be05a4590970145e90a is a sticky Move Object (ObjectCore.owner = 0x0, non-transferable). vault::VaultAccount.extend_ref stored at iusd-vault contract 0x2981d7952151389d3820c4d4e2602e6ce4e8df7c2675ef88626efa110fa20aa6. Confirmed from tx 4dbe5cba...: OFT LayerZero messaging_composer::ComposeDelivered triggers AUSD0 mint by OFT contract 0xf407bc..., followed by vault MintEvent minting iUSD 1:1. vault module functions are private/friend-only — no external mint path. vault::ModuleStore.admin = self (0x2981d7...).

controls.label: iusd-vault multisig admin (3-of-4)
controls.evidence: Initia REST: iusd-vault contract (0x2981d795...) has MultisigWallet resource with name 'iusd-vault', threshold 3 (each member weight 1), 4 voting members: 0xa5a8f716d5..., 0xc24c6072be..., 0x21b8a1fa32..., 0x6c7034c703... (plus 2 proposers with weight 0). Multisig governs config changes to the vault; the vault's mint function itself is triggered automatically by AUSD0 deposits (no vote required per mint). No modules/guards detected beyond standard MultisigWallet mechanics.

controls.label: AUSD0 LayerZero OFT admin multisig (3-of-5)
controls.evidence: Initia REST: AUSD0 OFT contract (0xf407bcfb...) has oapp_store::OAppStore.admin = 0x486bc26c1ed1c199ca550cf8953e00421b4ca2cb4ad9967f7dc8db384782a02d. That address is 'AUSD0 Multisig - Weighted' with threshold 30 (3-of-5 × weight 10 each). 5 members with weight 10: 0xe4c4b7..., 0x41f9dd..., 0x20ee9a..., 0xb67236..., 0x2d2ada...; 1 proposer weight 1: 0xc18847.... This controls LayerZero OFT routing for AUSD0, which caps iUSD supply.

review.evidence: Initia REST: 0xfd6a07... is a sticky Move Object (owner=0x0, non-transferable); vault::VaultAccount.extend_ref stored at iusd-vault contract 0x2981d795...; only the vault can sign for 0xfd6a07 and invoke managed_coin mint. Confirmed from tx 4dbe5cba...: LayerZero OFT triggers AUSD0 mint by 0xf407bc..., then vault MintEvent mints iUSD 1:1. iusd-vault is governed by a 3-of-4 MultisigWallet for config; AUSD0 OFT admin is 3-of-5 multisig 0x486bc26c... Mint path fully traced: supply bounded by AUSD0 deposited, no free-mint path, all admins identified.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All iUSD is minted on Initia by the iusd-vault against AUSD0 deposited into its sticky vault object. AUSD0 is the LayerZero OFT representation of Agora AUSD, so the exact iUSD deployment inherits the local vault, AUSD0 OFT administration, and LayerZero messaging failure domains.

routes.reviewNote: Composite route: LayerZero delivers AUSD0 to Initia, then the iusd-vault locks the local AUSD0 representation and mints the exact iUSD contract 1:1.
